name: Power and distribution transformers
description: Oil-immersed and dry-type transformers stepping between the Malaysian voltage tiers: 500/275 kV and 275/132 kV grid banks, 132/33/11 kV distribution units and 11-33 kV/415 V site transformers, to MS IEC 60076 (IEC 60076 adopted).

subtypes.name: Generator step-up and grid power transformers (275-500 kV)
Distribution transformers (11-33 kV / 415-433 V, Dyn11, ONAN)
Dry-type and cast-resin for indoor sites

specifications.basis: Malaysian tiers 500, 275, 132, 33, 11 kV and 415-433 V are joined by transformers; the LV secondary is 415 V nominal or 433 V rated depending on specification

specifications.basis: Malaysian public-sector (JKR-type) specification for 11 kV/433 V Dyn11 hermetically sealed distribution transformers: 1,000 kVA no-load loss limit 1,600 W

specifications.metric: indicative cost, 1000 kVA 11 kV/0.4 kV oil-immersed transformer
specifications.basis: Indicative export quotes: aluminium-wound standard units about USD 7,000-12,000; copper-wound low-loss IEC units USD 12,000-20,000. Malaysian landed prices are expected 30-60% above these FOB figures for duties, SST, compliance testing and local margin (roughly MYR 80,000-150,000 for a compliant S13-class copper unit). Indicative only.
